subject.title: fix: pace delivery recovery after startup outages

question: Should paced startup recovery be allowed to defer eligible tail entries after the existing 60s budget, or must this PR guarantee a follow-up paced drain without another restart?
rationale: The patch intentionally counts pacing delay against an existing deadline, and maintainers should own whether that message-delivery tradeoff is acceptable before merge.

options.title: Fix tail backlog recovery
options.body: Require this PR to keep pacing while preventing eligible entries from being stranded solely because pacing consumed the startup recovery budget.

options.title: Accept budget deferral
options.body: Merge the current behavior knowing that large outage backlogs may need another startup or reconnect to finish replaying.

recommendation.title: Fix tail backlog recovery
recommendation.body: Require this PR to keep pacing while preventing eligible entries from being stranded solely because pacing consumed the startup recovery budget.
